veil-v2-hovers.detail: Light pressure (0.0174 m/s²) and Venus's gravity both point toward Venus; the shade falls with 0.0347 m/s² and reaches Venus in about 1 day.

veil-hovers.detail: At 1.110 million km sunward the residual is 0.0e+0 m/s², nil; slats trim the small, slow drift of this unstable point by tilting.

second-law.detail: Pump work 2.83e+27 J for 5.28e+26 J of heat, at least the 9.05e+26 J Carnot demands even if every joule left from 737 K.

graphite-for-caps.detail: 4.75e+17 kg of graphite by the end of sealing; the caps need 3.00e+17 kg.

ice-arrives.detail: Last launch 2035.80, transfer 1.15 yr, last arrival 2036.95.

ring-energy-loop.detail: Ring 7.22e+19 W recovered against 6.48e+19 W drawn by the Railheads.

ring-net-force.detail: Catching half the Bricks eastbound and half westbound cancels the twist, not the force: 8.1e+15 N remains along Venus's orbital motion. An orbital ring has no stiff way to hand an in-plane force to the planet; its spare lift is 3.0e+13 N, 266 times too little.

ring-lowering-load.detail: Lowering 2.17e+12 kg/s needs at least 4.7e+15 N; the rotor's spare lift is 3.0e+13 N, 154 times too little.

foundry-affords-veil.detail: Foundry machinery at the Veil's close date: 2.17e+12 kg; Veil: 5.41e+11 kg.

foundry-affords-lattice.detail: Foundry at full power date: 1.34e+14 kg; Lattice: 5.14e+13 kg.

frost-before-sealing.detail: The simulated Frost Towers finish on 11 September 2036; the last caps are sealed on 15 September 2036.

genesis-by-deadline.detail: Seeding waits for the oxygen (30 September 2036) and for the oceans to hold their pH (14 December 2036), so it begins on 14 December 2036; doubling every 1 d, the cells reach bloom density on 25 December 2036, against a deadline of 31 December 2036.

earth-like-by-deadline.detail: The day-by-day simulation reaches Earth-like conditions on 2036-09-30; the deadline is 2036-12-31.

energy-closes.detail: Lattice supply 7.79e+27 J against demand 8.28e+27 J: -6% spare before the Ring's recovered energy, 25% once the Ring powers the Railheads.

energy-closes-with-ring.detail: The Lattice delivers 7.8 × 10²⁷ J against 5.9 × 10²⁷ J once the Ring powers the Railheads, and the Ring recovers 5.3 × 10²⁷ J against the 2.4 × 10²⁷ J of launches it pays for.
